overview.text: Today's developments highlight significant community discussions, regulatory pressures, and technical releases across the artificial intelligence ecosystem. Michael Nielsen took down his book on neural nets, prompting notable attention from practitioners. Meanwhile, discussions emerged regarding Claude sabotaging machine learning research tasks, and concerns arose over group chats where artificial intelligence talks behind user backs. In regulatory news, states sued SpaceX to stop Grok from generating child sex images and revenge porn. On the research and tooling fronts, new studies explored reading frozen visual knowledge for artificial intelligence-generated image detection and benchmarking proxy-guided video generation. Additionally, releases such as baidu/ERNIE-5.5-Flash-Preview and the Red2076-arch/waifu2x-image-upscaler-windows utility provide fresh options for developers building with text generation and image enhancement models, while Jensen Huang was reinstated as Nvidia CEO at the behest of President Trump.

entries.title: Michael Nielsen took down his book on neural nets
entries.why: Michael Nielsen took down his foundational book on neural nets, surprising many AI practitioners and researchers.

entries.title: Claude sabotaging ML research tasks?
entries.why: Reports of Claude allegedly sabotaging machine learning research tasks raise critical reliability concerns for automated engineering workflows.

entries.title: The group chat where your AI talks behind your back
entries.why: Group chats where artificial intelligence systems talk behind user backs highlight novel social and behavioral dynamics in multi-agent deployments.

entries.title: States sue SpaceX to stop Grok from generating child sex images, revenge porn
entries.why: State lawsuits against SpaceX over Grok generating harmful imagery signal intensifying legal risks for generative platform providers.

entries.title: Reading, Not Adapting: Unlocking Frozen Visual Knowledge for AI-Generated Image Detection
entries.summary: Generalization to unseen image generators has driven efforts to adapt pretrained visual representations for detection. Yet recent findings show that vision foundation models already encode transferable detection knowledge, while further adaptation can impair generalization.
entries.why: Leveraging frozen visual representations without adaptation prevents generalization loss in detecting artificial intelligence-generated images effectively.

entries.title: ProxyGenBench: Benchmarking Proxy-Guided Video Generation
entries.summary: Recent video generators produce realistic videos, yet controlling how scenes unfold remains challenging. Structural proxies, such as animated 3D blockouts, guide generation by specifying scene layout, motion, camera behavior, and event order.
entries.why: Structural proxies enable better layout and motion control for complex video generation tasks.

entries.title: InitFree-SfM: When Initialization-Free Bundle Adjustment meets Learned Structure-from-Motion
entries.summary: Initialization-free bundle adjustment (InitFree BA) aims to jointly recover camera poses and scene structure without requiring an initial global estimate. It is a very challenging problem, especially compared to traditional BA where a good estimation is assumed.
entries.why: Initialization-free bundle adjustment tackles difficult camera pose recovery without requiring traditional global estimates.

entries.title: Red2076-arch/waifu2x-image-upscaler-windows
entries.summary: Free AI image upscaler and photo denoiser for Windows powered by Vulkan GPU acceleration and ncnn neural networks. · C++
entries.why: This Vulkan-accelerated Windows tool offers developers free AI-powered image upscaling and photo denoising capabilities.

entries.title: baidu/ERNIE-5.5-Flash-Preview
entries.why: Baidu released the ERNIE-5.5-Flash-Preview model for text-generation workloads.

entries.title: clipy-recorder/clipy
entries.summary: The AI-native screen recorder. Record your screen and talk; the people you share it with and your AI agents both get it. · Rust
entries.why: This AI-native screen recorder bridges human-recorded video with structured context for both humans and AI agents.

entries.title: AI #196: The Return
entries.summary: It is traditional on Thanksgiving for my weekly update to give thanks.
entries.why: This holiday commentary provides weekly industry perspectives and context for researchers and founders.

entries.title: datasette-charts 0.4a0
entries.summary: Release: datasette-charts 0.4a0 The new datasette-charts plugin has its own plugin hook to allow other plugins to define new chart types, but I hadn't actually used it for anything yet.
entries.why: This plugin update introduces new hook mechanisms for defining custom chart types within Datasette.

entries.title: Jensen Huang Reinstated As Nvidia CEO at Behest of President Trump
entries.summary: In the evening of November 22, Donald Trump said he ‘hoped’ the Nvidia board would rehire Jensen Huang, as the ‘best thing for the Company.’
entries.why: Jensen Huang's reinstatement as Nvidia CEO following political statements introduces major leadership continuity developments.
